description: This source file defines the main application entry point for a SwiftUI-based Notes application. It includes the main App struct 'NotesAppApp' which sets up dependency injection, configures environment objects, and determines the remote API usage strategy. It also contains a helper method for creating the appropriate RemoteNotesAPI implementation based on build configuration.
